x: Walker just beat Eddie Short for second place, and then came Jack Braughton 5th, Bill Lucas 7th, Archie Bedford 9th and Len Herbert 11th. All the first five were selected to run for Surrey in the Inter-Counties race at York, and Jack Brown 7th in the Kent race and A.

Walker brought us to 5th on the third leg, and we then ran Jack Braughton in an endeavour to overhaul the leaders. Jack ran a fine lap in 14.7 which was only 5 seconds outside the course record set up by C.
Charlie Walker came in next and so won the Blackstaffe Shield but he only just held off Braughton in the straight. Jumbo Masters came next and Jack Brown only got 3rd Championship medal this year.

As I have said the race started in perfect weather and at 3½ miles things had sorted themselves out with a leading group of 12, then Colin 14th and another group of 12 or so led by our second claim member Jack Braughton, with Eric 24th.
